A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was married to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Untos Poquot]]. She perished in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by the [[Death Star/Legends|first Death Star]]. Because of this, her husband hated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] with an unsurpassed fury.<ref name="BI" />
